rows.grounds: compound vāma (left) + jaṅghā (thigh) in locative singular feminine indicating location

items.question: On which part of the body is this placement located?
premises: The preceding context concerns mantra-śakti and its application.
A specific bodily location is designated by a locative compound.
The compound specifies the left thigh as that location.
items.inference: The placement is located on the left thigh.
uncertainties: The exact ritual action performed on the left thigh is not explicitly stated in this verse alone.
